posts.title: Day 1 in Paris – Arrival and First Impressions
posts.body: We arrived at Charles de Gaulle airport after a long flight. The city is absolutely stunning. Checked into our cozy hotel near the Marais district. Walked along the Seine and had our first croissant – magnifique!

posts.title: Day 2 – The Eiffel Tower Experience
posts.body: Woke up early to beat the crowds at the Eiffel Tower. The view from the top is breathtaking. Had lunch at a small bistro nearby. In the evening we took a river cruise along the Seine.

posts.title: Day 3 – Louvre Museum Marathon
posts.body: Spent the entire day at the Louvre. You could spend a week here and not see everything. The Mona Lisa was smaller than expected but the rest of the collection is extraordinary.

posts.title: Rome Day 1 – Eternal City Awaits
posts.body: Arrived in Rome by train from Paris. The Colosseum at sunset is something I will never forget. Had the best carbonara of my life at a tiny restaurant near Trastevere.

posts.title: Rome Day 2 – Vatican and Sistine Chapel
posts.body: Visited the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel. Michelangelo's ceiling is absolutely breathtaking. Tossed a coin in the Trevi Fountain – we're definitely coming back!

posts.title: Tokyo Day 1 – Shibuya Chaos
posts.body: Landed in Narita and took the Narita Express to the city. Shibuya crossing at rush hour is organized chaos. Tried ramen for the first time – absolutely incredible.

posts.title: Tokyo Day 2 – Temples and Shrines
posts.body: Visited Senso-ji temple in Asakusa in the morning. The contrast between ancient temples and modern skyscrapers is fascinating. Had matcha everything today.

posts.title: Barcelona Day 1 – Gaudi Magic
posts.body: Sagrada Familia is unlike anything I have ever seen. Gaudi's architecture is otherworldly. The Barceloneta beach in the evening was perfect.

posts.title: יום מספר 1: נוחתים בפריז
posts.body: הגענו למלון, פרקנו מזוודות וישר יצאנו להסתובב. עברנו בין פטיסריז מדהימים ועד לחנויות בוטיק לעיצוב הבית. אספתי המון רעיונות חדשים לסידור הדירה וקניתי חומרי גלם מעולים."
